sections.content: szép ('beautiful/pretty') and csúnya ('ugly') are a common opposite pair, and kényelmes ('comfortable') has no single-word opposite taught yet -- it's usually negated instead: nem kényelmes ('not comfortable').
Learning adjectives in opposite pairs (szép/csúnya) makes them easier to recall than learning each word alone -- try to always pair a new adjective with its opposite as you meet it.
